name: notch-fight
description: Plays the Notch Fight clips in a band above the prompt while Claude works

display.title: Display
display.description: image: the real PNG frames (kitty, Ghostty), falls back to raster elsewhere. raster: coloured quadrant-block cells, any terminal. sextant: 2x3-pixel block cells, 50% more detail than raster (kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm, Orca, VS Code). octant: 2x4-pixel cells, twice raster's detail (Unicode 16: kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm; boxes in Orca)

rows.title: Height
rows.description: Terminal rows the clip takes (4 to 24); the width follows the clip's shape. sextant at 21 rows shows the clips at their native resolution

repo.title: notch-fight checkout
repo.description: Where the notch-fight checkout is (its build/clips). Empty: the checkout this plugin is in
